notablePrerequisites: Grim Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Grim Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
